name: Fenekus
backstory: Child of Fenserika and Niekus; raised in Salthos Cruzados on waits near the Salthos house's own square on..., and carries some knowledge of CONFLICT-01.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Learned that Darnus has died.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Nakus has died.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Dorakus and Darnus now have a child, Doraknus.
Heard that Niekus and Nieragan now have a child, Nierakus.

criterion.standard: measures a life by whether CONFLICT-01 is still remembered rightly
criterion.wasted_life: forgetting what CONFLICT-01 actually meant, the way most people already have

routines.routine_actions: stands at the square's edge on petition days, has stopped expecting an answer about the old match, and instead keeps track of who else the house has left waiting

arc.premise: Fenekus has inherited her mother's old question about the broken match, but instead of chasing the true account further back, she's started organizing a formal reconciliation reading at the square - both houses' versions spoken aloud together, once, so the argument has somewhere to end rather than just repeat.
